basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm Alex, a college student majoring in environmental science. I recently discovered Reddit and I'm loving the community vibes here. I live in Colorado and spend most of my free time outdoors, either mountain biking or hiking. I'm also a huge fan of cyclocross and have a passion for restoring old Jeep Wranglers. When I'm not outside, I'm probably catching up on the latest horror stories or indulging in some light-hearted reality TV gossip. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes or during weekends. Currently single, I'm just enjoying life and exploring my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of environmental science from my college courses, which sometimes helps when discussing related topics on Reddit. My interest in cycling and Jeep restoration comes from hands-on experience and learning through online forums and YouTube tutorials.
